verdict.rationale: A local runtime emulator is a fair axis for a cloud app platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents no Fly.io local simulator or emulator. Available items cover remote deployment via `fly launch`, Machines VMs, and Docker-image conversion. Running the same Docker image locally would only be a user-side workaround, not a first-party capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime
